parts.text: Fig. 8.1 shows the outline of a bar magnet. A compass needle is being used to show the magnetic field pattern around the bar magnet. The needle is a small, freely-pivoted magnet. Fig. 8.1

parts.text: (a) The compass is placed to the left of the N pole of the magnet. Its needle points in the direction shown by the arrow. Four other positions are indicated around the magnet, each marked by a circle. In each circle, draw an arrow to indicate the direction in which the compass needle would point at each of these positions. Other magnetic fields can be ignored. [4]
